text: But I was always interested in the other world, the outside of Morocco, music and whatever. I was always interested in that. Did you know that you wanted to be a musician for your life? I did, actually, yeah. It was funny. I always dreamed to have a band touring and going outside all over the world. It was always my dream to do that.
